newsitem.title: CHINA: China to issue 20 bln yuan of 7-year T-bills.
newsitem.headline: China to issue 20 bln yuan of 7-year T-bills.

text.p: China will issue 20 billion yuan worth of seven-year tradeable treasury bills from November 1 to 20, state television quoted the Ministry of Finance as saying on Wednesday.
The bills would be underwritten by primary dealers following open bidding before being offered to the public through the clearing system of the Shanghai and Shenzhen stock exchanges, it said.
Individuals and other investors could buy the bills through their securities accounts at securities institutions, it said.
